# ANALYSIS: Stage-1 Grinder Backtest Plan

**Filed:** 2026-07-07  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Running the grinder harness on the current candidate set will produce Stage-1 metrics (edge_capture, max drawdown, concentration) needed to filter candidates for Stage-2 evaluation and ensure OP-16 compliance.

## Mechanism

We will execute the grinder harness (`backtest/autoresearch/grinder.py`) over the 16-month OPRA dataset (Jan 2025–Jun 2026), applying each candidate's logic as defined in their respective markdown files. For each candidate we will collect per-trade P&L, compute edge_capture per OP-16 (sum of engine P&L on J winners minus sum of max(0, engine loss on J losers)), max drawdown, and concentration (top5_pct of total P&L). Results will be recorded in a temporary scorecard for review.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline  
2. **Sample bias:** 16-month OPRA dataset (Jan 2025–Jun 2026); selection method = all candidates currently listed in `_LEADERBOARD.md`; overfit risk = high if we tune to J anchors without OOS validation.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window to be performed after Stage-1)  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will run realistic OPRA simulator with cached bid/ask and slippage model)  
5. **Failure modes:** worst day, max drawdown, blow-up scenario unknown until backtest completes  
6. **Concentration:** unknown until backtest completes (top5_pct to be reported)  

## Pre-merge gate

Grinder must pass:  
- gym validators (no regressions)  
- walk-forward analysis (OOS/IS ratio ≥ 0.70)  
- real-fills check on top 3 J days (diff < ±20% vs BS-sim)  
- concentration check (top5_pct ≤ 200% to avoid extreme tail reliance)  

## Confidence

3 / 10 -- we have not yet executed the grinder; this analysis outlines the plan. Confidence will increase after Stage-1 results are in hand.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This analysis is purely meta; it does not alter any existing candidate's status. Its purpose is to quantify edge_capture, max drawdown, and concentration for each candidate so that Chef can promote/demote based on OP-16 floors and other gates. No conflict with current leaderboard entries.
